content: Chrome Web Store Spam and Placement policy is the main removal vector unrelated to functionality: duplicate or near-duplicate listings from the same developer, disruptive notifications, keyword-stuffed descriptions, and automated detection of similarity to known-bad extensions. Reviews trigger on every update submission plus user abuse reports plus automated systems. One appeal is allowed per violation; further appeals for the same violation are rejected. Broad host_permissions and any remote code loading draw the most manual scrutiny.
